title: The Titanic, 1912
subtitle: Lifeboats and competing causes
claim: The Titanic disaster was so deadly mainly because the ship did not carry enough lifeboats.
plain: Many people died. The main reason: too few lifeboats.

clues.name: People and seats
clues.reason: there were seats for only about half the people.

clues.name: Legal requirements
clues.text: the ship was fulfilling all the requirements of the British Board of Trade.
clues.reason: the rules allowed too few boats, so the shortage was legal; it points to a deeper cause, the rules.

clues.name: Saved and lost
clues.reason: 706 is fewer than the 1,176 seats, so boats left with empty seats; how the boats were filled mattered too.

clues.name: Ice warnings
clues.text: On the third day out ice warnings were received by the wireless operators on the Titanic.
clues.reason: another cause, why the ship hit the ice at all.

clues.name: Ship speed
clues.text: the ship was going not less than 21 knots and the ship's speed was not reduced.

clues.name: Recommendation
clues.text: There should be enough lifeboats for all on board.
clues.reason: the investigators saw lifeboats as a key problem to fix.

title: The Great Chicago Fire, 1871
subtitle: A familiar story. An uncertain origin.
claim: Mrs. O'Leary's cow did not start the Great Chicago Fire. The cow story came from a newspaper, and the real cause is unknown.
plain: The famous cow story is not true. Nobody knows how the fire started.

clues.name: Inquiry finding
clues.text: we are unable to determine whether a spark from a chimney or a person started it.
clues.source: Board of Police and Fire Commissioners, 1871 inquiry
clues.reason: officials at the time could not find the cause.

clues.name: Reporter account
clues.text: A reporter, Michael Ahern, later said that he and other reporters made up the cow story. Accounts disagree about the year he said it.
clues.source: Chicago History Museum / Northwestern University, The O'Leary Legend
clues.reason: it supports the claim, but it is one person's statement made many years later, so it is weaker than G1.

clues.name: Barn location
clues.text: The fire started in or near the O'Leary family's barn on DeKoven Street.
clues.reason: it explains why people blamed the cow, but it fits both stories.

clues.name: After-fire photograph
clues.reason: it shows the damage, not how the fire began.

clues.name: Council resolution
clues.text: In 1997, the Chicago City Council passed a resolution clearing Mrs. O'Leary and her cow.
clues.reason: a vote 126 years later is an opinion, not new evidence.

clues.name: Human cost
clues.text: About 300 people died, and about 100,000 people lost their homes.
clues.reason: it shows how serious the fire was, not its cause.

title: The Frontier, 1893
subtitle: An explanation with limits
claim: The existence of an area of free land, its continuous recession, and the advance of American settlement westward, explain American development. The most important effect of the frontier has been in the promotion of democracy.
plain: Turner says: there was open land in the West, and settlers kept moving west. This is why America grew the way it did, and why it became more democratic.

clues.name: Census line
clues.text: there can hardly be said to be a frontier line.
clues.reason: it tells why Turner wrote in 1893, not whether he was right.

clues.name: Removal Act
clues.text: An Act to provide for an exchange of lands with the Indians residing in any of the states or territories, and for their removal west of the river Mississippi.
clues.reason: the land was not free; Native nations lived there, and the US government removed many of them by law and by force.

clues.name: Homestead Act
clues.text: A settler could claim 160 acres of public land by living on it and farming it for five years.
clues.reason: settlement westward was real, and the government pushed it.

clues.name: Wyoming vote
clues.text: In 1869, Wyoming Territory gave women the right to vote, before any state did.

clues.name: Voting barriers
clues.text: In 1890, Mississippi's new constitution added a poll tax and a literacy test. They were used to stop Black men from voting.
clues.source: Mississippi Department of Archives and History
clues.reason: in Turner's time, democracy was shrinking for many Americans, so the frontier was not the whole story.

clues.name: House of Burgesses
clues.text: In 1619, colonists in Virginia met as an elected assembly, the House of Burgesses.
clues.reason: self-government in America had older roots in the East.
